728-1445-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1719-2645-3430-3756.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

767-4213-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-4213-4687.description:
Activate Hankyu by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

4247-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4247-4302-4875.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4268-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4268-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7831-7835.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7831-7835.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-3504.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-3504.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mercurial Pretender and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-3504.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-2511-4871-6887.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-2033-5295-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-5295-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2762-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

851-1274-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-1274-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1682-2366-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2366-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

141-554-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-6798.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1640-6843.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Pariah's Shield causes that damage to be redirected to Anti-Venom.
Anti-Venom will then prevent the damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on it instead.

465-3742-4251-5929-6968.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3525-5251-5268.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {U}.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

147-5260-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5260-5686.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5260-5686.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

3293-5226-5721-6664.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5226-5721-6664.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5226-5721-6664.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1012-4050-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
1012-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1669-3470-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
1669-3470-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger that many times.
Resolve all Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

411-4103-4613-6258.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-4103-4613-6258.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact / Creature with "{T}: Add Mana" that can tap upon ETB (Mana Rock)

1170-5078-5243--30.easyPrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
1170-5078-5243--30.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2105-2921-2923.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat each combat phase.

2499-3448-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Stadium Vendors.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding four mana of any color.
Repeat.

385-1069-1778-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Mortarpod attached to Memnite.
You control at least three artifacts.
385-1069-1778-4763.description:
Activate Memnite by sacrificing it.
Memnite dies, triggering Koll, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Memnite ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate Mortarpod's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Memnite.
Repeat.

413-2058-2073-4659.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any creature.
Salvaging Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Flayer Husk, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve Blasting Station's trigger, untapping it.
Resolve Flayer Husk's trigger, creating a 0/0 Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
When the Germ enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers.
In response, repeat from step 1.
